Name: Pelican xVASynth - Updated
Author: Nahlbrii
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10250]Pelican xVASynth[/url] was originally created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url], as a mod utilizing xVASynth to provide real-time voice synthesis based on Stardew Valley character dialogue. It has not been updated since December 2001 and thus no longer works in the latest version of Stardew Valley and SMAPI. Since permissions on the original mod are open, I updated it to work with the latest SMAPI in the latest version of Stardew Valley.

While I was at it, I also fixed, what I viewed as, a minor bug: I added an [i]interrupt [/i]feature for when the player skips dialogue, so it doesn't generate the audio for each skipped dialogue box and play them all at the same time. I also reformatted the config file to make it easier to edit manually, if desired. Fixed a bug where it only ever detected vanilla NPCs, now you can assign voices to mod added NPCs as well! I also added the option to configure the pitch for each character's voice, just in case one wants to use the same voice model for multiple NPCs, but still want them to sound different, or even sound different from the original voice model.

With these, I feel the mod is now complete as-is so I bumped the version to an official [b]1.0.0[/b]!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Download and install xVASynth (either from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/44184]here [/url]on Nexus Mods or through [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1765720/xVASynth/]Steam[/url]. If you're brave enough, you can also build it from their [url=https://github.com/DanRuta/xVA-Synth]GitHub[/url]).[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Download and install your desired voice models (either manually from various sources, or link your Nexus account in xVASynth, and download them through it).[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Download the [b]xVASynth plugin[/b] from the Downloads section of [i]this[/i] modpage and unzip it to the plugins folder of xVASynth (resources/app/plugins)[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to your Stardew Valley mods folder.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Download and install the [b]Pelican xVASynth[/b] mod from the Downloads section to your Stardew Valley mods folder.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Setup instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Open xVASynth.[/*]
[*]Enable the real-time TTS plugin (click the puzzle piece icon to open the plugins window).[/*]
[*]Open Stardew Valley.[/*]
[*]Open the GMCM and select [b]Pelican xVASynth[/b] in the menu.[/*]
[*]Choose the voices you want for each character listed.[/*]
[*]Optional: set the pitch for each character.[/*]
[*]Save settings.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Usage instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Open xVASynth (Must be running in order for the mod to work).[/*]
[*]Make sure the plugin is still activated.[/*]
[*]Open Stardew Valley.[/*]
[*]Enjoy.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Uses xVASynth to generate voice lines for each assigned character in real-time as their dialogue pops up on-screen.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]You choose how each character sounds by assigning a voice model to them and adjusting the pitch.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Dialogue playback can be interrupted and/or skipped when you skip the dialogue itself.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Built for and tested on SMAPI 4.4.0[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Requires Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game configuration. (manual editing of the config.json is allowed if you'd rather)[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Requires xVASynth to run in the background in order to generate the audio.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]
